About Us

Our Story

Born in the Hills of Manipur, Queen Captivated was founded with a singular mission: to empower entrepreneurs and businesses in Manipur and the Northeast with world-class consulting that was previously out of reach.

Located in the heart of Ukhrul Town, we serve as the bridge between local ambition and global standards — delivering premium guidance across IT, finance, education, architecture, retail, restaurant, and beyond.

We believe every entrepreneur in Northeast India deserves the same quality of strategic advice that companies in major cities receive.

🎯

Our Mission

Empower Northeast India's entrepreneurs with premium, world-class consulting services.

👥

Our Approach

Bridging the gap between local ambition and global standards through hands-on strategic guidance.

🧠

AI-Powered Insights

We leverage advanced AI-driven insights to enable smarter, faster, and data-driven business decisions.
